name: Dual Environment
notes: Normal Mode is an ordinary city desktop; Private Mode is a separate encrypted account with JARED and your engineering workspace.
Private storage is a LUKS2 home encrypted with AES-256-XTS, unlocked only by its own password and sealed when you exit.
Every lock covers all displays first and returns to the same city lock screen. Unlocking it opens Normal Mode.
Automatic locking after inactivity, before sleep and when the lid closes. Private Mode can seal itself while locked.
The Vault adds a second AES-256-GCM encrypted folder with its own passphrase inside Private Mode.
Private Mode turns your secondary display into a configurable command center.
